title: A Secret World
note: 산호초를 바닷속 도시에 비유해 소개하는 K1 기사

paragraphs: A coral reef is like an underwater city. Many ocean plants grow there. Animals live among them. Reefs provide shelter for animals. And they provide food. Take a peek inside this watery world.
Corals look like rocks. But they are animals. They have a hard outer skeleton. Many corals make up a reef.
A reef is a home for many animals. These fish live there. They coexist with the reef. The turtle is just visiting.
It is the world’s largest coral reef system. Australia is nearby. The reef is so big, it can be seen from space.
They are home to lots of life. But they are in danger. Trash and warming waters are harmful to them. How can you help?

questions.q: What is a coral reef like?
Corals look like rocks. But what are they?
Where is the world's largest coral reef system?
Name two things a reef gives to animals.
What is harmful to coral reefs?
How big is the largest reef?
questions.answer: It is so big that it can be seen from space.

writing.prompt: The story asks, "How can you help?" Write one way you can help coral reefs.
writing.sample: 쓰레기를 바다에 버리지 않기 같은 답이면 정답입니다. 기사 마지막 문단과 연결되는지 봐 주세요.
